title: BBA Aviation Management
description: A comprehensive undergraduate program focusing on airport operations, passenger handling, cargo management, and aviation safety.
overview: The BBA in Aviation Management is designed to prepare students for leadership roles in the fast-paced aviation industry. Combining core business management principles with specialized aviation operations, this 3-year program ensures graduates are ready to tackle challenges in airline management, airport operations, and allied sectors.

title: Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM)
description: An intensive degree program covering all aspects of hospitality, including food production, F&B service, front office, and housekeeping.
overview: The Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM) program transforms students into polished hospitality professionals. Through a blend of rigorous classroom instruction and extensive practical training in our mock setups, students learn the intricacies of managing world-class hotels, resorts, and restaurants.

title: Master of Business Administration
description: A premium postgraduate program designed to build strategic leadership and advanced management skills for the global hospitality sector.
overview: Our MBA program offers advanced business education tailored for the hospitality and service industries. It focuses on strategic management, international hospitality operations, and corporate leadership, empowering graduates to take on senior executive roles globally.

title: Post Graduate Diploma in Aviation Management (PGDAM)
description: An integrated PG diploma program focusing on advanced aviation operations, fleet management, and airline economics.
overview: The PGDAM is an extensive program designed for students aiming for specialized roles in aviation. Over three years, the curriculum covers in-depth operational procedures, regulatory frameworks, and the business strategies that drive modern airlines and airports.

title: Diploma in Aviation Management (DAM)
description: A fast-track diploma program for aspiring cabin crew and ground staff, emphasizing grooming, communication, and basic aviation operations.
overview: The Diploma in Aviation Management (DAM) is a specialized 1-year course focused on immediate employability. It thoroughly trains students in cabin crew responsibilities, ground handling, personality development, and passenger service excellence.

title: Post Graduate Diploma in Hotel Management (PGDHM)
description: A focused PG diploma equipping graduates with advanced skills in hotel administration and operational leadership.
overview: Designed for graduates from any discipline, the PGDHM offers a fast-tracked immersion into hotel management. The 2-year program focuses on advanced operational techniques, leadership, and the financial aspects of running hospitality establishments.

title: Diploma in Hotel Management (DHM)
description: An entry-level, highly practical diploma for immediate entry into the hospitality workforce.
overview: The DHM is perfect for students seeking quick entry into the hospitality sector. Available in 6-month and 1-year formats, it covers the absolute essentials of hotel operations, focusing heavily on practical skills in food service and housekeeping.
